name: Hater
descriptionText:
Hater is an archetype that specializes in complete and utter destruction of a singular foe.

Hatred Token: While a character holds your Hatred Token, you are effectively Challenged by them. Hatred Token cannot be discarded by anyone, other than the character who has given it. When a character, holding a Hatred Token loses a health bar or is Taken Out, the character who has given it Heals 2 times.

abilities.name: Focused Hater
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn give any enemy you know is present in the combat a Hatred token. You cannot give another character a Hatred token, until the current character who is holding it is Taken Out. After that, add X to your Action Pool. X is equal to the damage on the current health bar of a character with a Hatred Token, to a maximum of 13. X cannot be lower than 3.

abilities.name: Fused Hater
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn give any enemy you know is present in the combat a Hatred token. You cannot give another character a Hatred token, until the current character who is holding it is Taken Out. After that, add X to your Action Pool. X is equal to half the damage on the current health bar of a character with a Hatred Token, rounded up, to a maximum of 9. X cannot be lower than 2.

abilities.name: Frantic Hater
abilities.rulesText: At the start of this turn give any enemy you know is present in the combat a Hatred token. You cannot give another character a Hatred token, until the current character who is holding it is Taken Out. After that, add X to your Action Pool. X is equal to the damage on the current health bar of a character with a Hatred Token, to a maximum of 13. X cannot be lower than 3.

actions.name: Pursuit
actions.rulesText: Pull yourself up to 4 to an enemy holding your Hatred Token. Then, deal 1 damage to them.
